user.description: Count cigarettes in Home Assistant. Settings (cost, breaks, reminders, entities that count) are under Configure after adding.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Ciggie Counter is already set up.

data_description.day_start_hour: Cigarettes before this hour still count for the day before (e.g. 4 for night owls).
data_description.interval_mode: Calculated: the rest of the daily target is spread over the remaining waking time, smoking faster makes breaks longer.
data_description.count_sources: Buttons, contacts, switches or event entities. Each press or each change to on counts one cigarette.
data_description.next_allowed_reminder: Fires the event ciggie_counter_reminder (type next_allowed) – use it in an automation for TTS, Telegram …
data_description.nextcloud_url: Sync with the Nextcloud app "cigarettecounter" (from 0.9.11): the address you open Nextcloud with in the browser. Home Assistant takes over all entries from there and sends its own. Create an app password: Nextcloud → Settings → Security.

error.nextcloud_incomplete: For Nextcloud please fill in address, user and app password (or leave all three empty).
error.invalid_auth: Nextcloud rejected user or app password.
error.app_missing: The Nextcloud app "cigarettecounter" (from version 0.9.11) was not found.

count.name: Count cigarette
count.description: Counts a cigarette now or at a given time.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: Optional, for a cigarette you forgot. Default: now.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional label, e.g. the name of a button.

delete_last.name: Delete last cigarette
delete_last.description: Deletes the newest entry, e.g. after a double press.
